teams.title: Litigation Practice Team
teams.description: Full-service litigation team handling civil cases from intake through trial, with compliance oversight and billing support.

workflow.description: Sequential litigation workflow from case evaluation through trial preparation with compliance and administrative support

steps.task: Evaluate case merits, calculate statute of limitations, assess damages, develop litigation strategy, draft pleadings and motions, and manage discovery
Screen for conflicts of interest, verify ethics compliance, review AI usage disclosure requirements, and assess malpractice risk factors
Track court deadlines, organize evidence, log client communications, record time entries, and manage document filings

teams.title: Corporate Practice Team
teams.description: Transactional team handling corporate matters with full billing and compliance support.

workflow.description: Sequential corporate workflow from contract preparation through billing with compliance oversight

steps.task: Draft and review contracts, manage clause libraries, prepare engagement letters, and track document versions through transaction closing
Screen conflicts, verify data privacy compliance, generate AI usage disclosures, and review ethics considerations
Record time entries, generate invoices, manage trust account transactions, and analyze matter profitability

teams.title: Firm Management Team
teams.description: Executive team providing firm-wide operational oversight, financial management, and strategic planning.

workflow.description: Sequential management workflow from performance analysis through financial review to compliance audit

steps.task: Review firm KPIs, analyze attorney utilization, forecast revenue, benchmark competitive positioning, and assess client satisfaction
Generate billing reports, reconcile trust accounts, analyze accounts receivable aging, and review matter profitability
Audit bar compliance deadlines, review CLE status, check trust account compliance, and assess firm-wide malpractice risk
